fields.summary_ko.0: Broadcom (AVGO) stock fell 5.1% following Rothschild & Co Redburn analyst Mike Harrison's downgrade to neutral, with price target reduced from $595 to $398 (9% upside).
fields.summary_ko.1: The analyst emphasized customer concentration (OpenAI, Anthropic) and their difficulty achieving funding self-sufficiency as primary concerns.
fields.summary_ko.2: Broadcom is providing credit guarantees of up to $63.0 billion for Anthropic and $50.0 billion for OpenAI, which the CEO justifies through the potential to generate $30.0 billion ARR per gigawatt.
